sources.PMQA40: Department of Mental Health (Thailand), Manual for assessing the status of government agencies as Bureaucracy 4.0 (PMQA 4.0), fiscal year 2568 (2025), pp. 5, 8, 9; based on OPDC PMQA 4.0 criteria, revised 2567 (2024). OCR of the cited pages in pmqa40_ocr_pages.txt.

assumptions.PMQA40: Item rating is one of three level values (300, 400, 500) per p. 9; no rating below Basic is defined in the cited pages, so none is modelled. AD-R guides how answers are written (p. 8) and is not a separately rated factor vector, so each item carries one rating.
